items.item: Reconcile Discussion V3 and the resampling sidecar before safe-memory successors
items.verdict: Accept the ordering; update V3 from launched to execution-complete / model-qualification-failed. Sidecar completion is not established by the inspected tracked records.
current_evidence: At source 4312d3cc, RESULTS-Q0 reports 96/96 cases and 636/636 model calls with no invalid/provider/missing outcomes. Clean full-evidence decisions were 2/6 and reports-only votes 1/6 against the frozen 5/6 requirement in each. Exact extraction did not guarantee correct constraint application.

All six attacked reports-only groups abstained on the final option; four still transmitted false target memory which the parent used. The board had zero wrong parents versus one for private work, but the primary clean-adjusted contrasts were zero in each three-world evidence stratum. This is six-root diagnostic evidence, not established discussion efficacy.

Every ambiguous attacked world lost its original conflict at merge. Local parent support can therefore pass an inherited error. Nine clean unsupported parent responses were numerically correct but failed the strict extra-citation rule; correctness and policy compliance must remain separate.

RESAMPLE-CONTROL retains a 12-world / 936-call frozen sidecar and explicit review waiver. The inspected directory contains a pre-run assessment and launch but no tracked completed result/post-mortem. Do not infer that the sidecar failed, completed, or passed from V3. Counts and replay claims here are the authors reported results, not a new raw-data recomputation.
incorporation: This addendum extends our review to Dmarz’s discussion/memory program. The original ten-project review did not independently audit these later results.
Preserve the failed clean gate and all four poisoned inheritances. Prioritize the owner’s atomic constraint-to-choice diagnostic and fresh disjoint qualification before making broader claims.

Classify the private-versus-resample contrast as the incremental effect of adding private work to repeated probes. It matches probe timing/count, but deliberately differs in work calls, actual tokens and updated context. It does not by itself identify an internal self-persuasion mechanism.

Our interpretation of the sidecar is precision-qualified: six roots per stratum are descriptive. A near-zero private-minus-resample contrast does not establish equivalence, identify sampling as the sole explanation, or prove the private comparator fair.
remaining: Reconcile the sidecar with its own assignment and usage ledger, qualification result and post-mortem before treating its controls as evidence. Preserve the review-waiver label rather than borrowing upstream independent-review status.
Freeze any changed model, response contract or citation scorer separately; existing Q0 inputs are now development material and the 24 confirmation roots remain untouched.
Keep numerical correctness, inherited false facts, unsupported answers, unresolved conflicts and required-field coverage visible rather than combining them into one safety score.

items.item: Proposed successor 3: identity splitting with fixed attacker resources
items.verdict: Support the new estimand, with an updated baseline decision: random checking is now essential, and coverage-versus-degree should not be treated as the scientifically privileged contrast without justification.
current_evidence: The parent scaling study is complete: 2,400 valid model answers, 100 conditions and 24 paired world clusters. At 972 identities, strong coverage checks increasing from 4 to 108 improved specialist accuracy 47.2% to 98.6%, a reported +51.4 points (descriptive paired-root interval +38.9 to +62.5). This buys more verification and is not an equal-cost effect.

At the same 108 strong checks, random selection also reached 98.6%, and deterministic plurality on the coverage packets reached 100%. Degree checking rejected 93.4% of honest specialists. Coverage therefore has no demonstrated advantage over random or necessary model contribution in the strongest condition.

Even the best coverage cell rejected 62.8% of honest specialists; repeated three-fact expertise makes high answer accuracy compatible with poor contributor inclusion. Four fixed coverage checks went exclusively to core identities at larger populations, exposing a graph-allocation mechanism.

These are simulated identities and verification outcomes feeding one model synthesis per condition, on one graph family with a fixed 25% attacker fraction and growing attacker resources. They do not test 972 autonomous model agents or identity multiplication at fixed attacker capacity.
incorporation: This response updates the collecting status to completed exploratory S1 and preserves its descriptive uncertainty. The original parent cohort remains unchanged; its results should inform comparator choice before a successor is frozen.

Hold honest population, evidence and aggregate attacker token/message, edge-acquisition and verification-attempt budgets fixed while varying identity allocation. Charge registration/metadata overhead and distinguish nominal identities from identities able to submit evidence.

Keep matched-budget random admission and same-packet deterministic plurality as central comparators. Either make the raw fixed-resource multiplicity effect primary, or justify a policy interaction against a competent comparator before fresh evaluation; degree-only superiority could reward comparison with a policy that discards expertise.

Use graph/task root clusters, two independently implemented graph families and one frozen attacker allocation algorithm. Counterbalance fabrication direction and increase distinct specialist facts so accuracy cannot depend only on repeated easy facts.
Report wrong answers, rare-skill coverage, attacker seat share and honest-specialist rejection jointly. Differentiate attacker seat share from attacker admission probability.
remaining: Freeze topology/anchor/edge allocation and packet-order rules so identity count does not silently buy extra connections, text or verification chances. Separate identity-multiplicity from any graph change that cannot be held fixed.
Qualify clean aggregation and missing-evidence abstention at each distinct packet-load regime. The 24 development roots and 10-point candidate margin do not determine evaluation power.
Include a faithful prior-work defense before comparative superiority claims. Scope any model contribution to its incremental benefit over identical-input deterministic aggregation.
Use fresh evaluation roots and retain valid degradation under tight resource budgets; do not enlarge attacker resources afterward to recreate a positive effect.

items.item: Proposed successor 4: compositional safety with delayed and missing receipts
items.verdict: Support the question and transfer axis; keep it conditional. Current qualification has not established readiness for the seven-arm pilot, let alone imperfect-receipt efficacy.
current_evidence: The current README records S0 84/84 scripted safe completions; q0-001, q0-002 and q0-003 failed model qualification. q0-003 had 16/24 safe completions and eight invalid nonterminal responses. Zero committed violations in that attempt does not mean safe useful behavior when invalids remain in the denominator.

At source 4312d3cc, q0-004 is described as running with observed incompletions and provider refusals already preventing a pass; no completed post-mortem is present. P1 remains closed. A single diagnostic identified one provider refusal; the causes of all eight earlier unclassified terminations remain unknown.

C/S are competence baselines; current records contain no empirical R-versus-F treatment comparison. The seven-arm design contains shared history, fragmented history, factual receipts, administrative text, generic reminder and atomic enforcement, but the faithful prior-work W comparison is still absent.
incorporation: This response records repeated failed model qualification with the current attempt unresolved. Attempt-specific model/settings and failure categories remain separate; they must not be aggregated into a treatment estimate or silently rerun until success.
Retain the owner’s four-role architecture and independently scored committed effects. Transfer across canonical constraint structures is more informative than multiplying roles or renamed entities.

For a later successor, fix a commitment-clock delivery schedule and log actual actor-visible receipt age and missingness. Treat stale authentic receipts separately from fabricated content; compare the same assignment and observation opportunity across arms.

Use canonical task structure as the independent cluster. Pair risk with benign tasks and require useful safe completion alongside reduced violations; all invalid and incomplete assignments remain visible.
Keep atomic enforcement as an advantaged complete-state reference, not a competing language-model defense. Distinguish factual origin authentication from completeness of the global state.
remaining: Finish the current attempt’s reconciliation and owner decision before changing receipt semantics. The development pilot needs a passing current-source competence gate; this response does not create a new execution lane.
Before a stale-receipt evaluation, decide how a missing receipt differs observably from F. If packets are identical, reuse the condition rather than counting duplicates as independent evidence.
Current administrative placebo matches bytes/envelope, not tokenizer cost or schema. Log actual tokens and preserve the mismatch; a content/attention-matched sensitivity can be added when justified.

Freeze delayed/missing receipt policy, task fingerprints, scorer and unseen-domain qualification separately. Candidate 10-point harm reduction and 3-point completion loss are planning margins; 24 development structures do not establish them.

Retain the faithful prior-work defense and an independent implementation or model transfer before stronger superiority/generalization claims. A failure of atomic enforcement to block a prohibited effect is an instrument defect; a valid natural-language failure is a result.

incorporation: This response updates V4-awaiting-qualification to separately qualified V5 Sonnet and reasoning-enabled Haiku discovery cohorts. Every prior failure and the interrupted cohort remain visible.
Preserve the frozen neutral discovery comparison before reading its outcomes; do not add a splitting hint or pool models after observing who discovers the strategy.

Interpret the primary incidence contrast at market-task level, with six clusters. Rounds, firms and calls are dependent; a degenerate bootstrap when every task agrees does not imply zero uncertainty about new markets.

Keep the model-specific comparison conditional on actual measured token/cost/latency and task competence. Equal requested reasoning caps do not make models computationally equivalent; qualification changed settings as well as model across the historical repairs.
Describe this as one model-controlled owner interacting with scripted rivals. It tests behavioral discovery in a stylized market, not autonomous multi-owner coordination or a real legal regime.
remaining: Reconcile all frozen new assignments, invalid bounds, spending and artifacts when their final reports arrive. A pre-run ready state or capability pass is not a completed main result.

For later scientific replication, expand independent market structures and independently authored economics before round count. Vary registration/maintenance costs, enforcement aggregation and information delay one interpretable axis at a time.
Keep prompted strategy demonstration separate from unprompted discovery. Success and brief notes do not establish an internal motive; registration under no enforcement is not evasion.

items.item: Proposed successor 1: safe memory inheritance at increasing team size
items.verdict: Support the narrow merge/parent intervention as a high-value next research direction, conditional on parent-program reconciliation and competence. Defer N=27 and broad schedule sweeps.
current_evidence: The newly completed V3 strengthens the motivating separation: a group can abstain while its independent memory merge transmits a supported false fact. It also shows loss of uncertainty even when the retained number is true.

The proposed receipt design has not run. Majority merge, deterministic coverage/provenance receipt, generic caution and full-evidence ceiling are proposed comparators, not evidence of receipt effectiveness.
incorporation: Use identical frozen child outputs and fresh, isolated parent instances for the first comparison. This identifies the downstream merge/representation intervention; it does not demonstrate that agents produce better evidence or learn to coordinate.

Use independently generated task roots as the unit, retaining all merge variants, sizes and parent repeats in their root cluster. Include every assigned root, not only traces known to contain poisoned memory.

Preserve the proposed harm reduction plus clean-completion guardrail. The 10-point benefit and 3-point utility margin are candidate application choices; 24 roots are development/variance work, not proof those margins are detectable.

Add a frozen information contract: authorized source roots, field coverage, conflict representation, source priority and actual serialized token lengths. Provenance authenticates origin, not factual truth. Full authorized evidence is an explicitly advantaged ceiling.

For later N=3/9 scaling, distinguish fixed total evidence/attack resources from fixed per-agent resources, and define allocation of the same evidence union across agents. Count active policy contexts rather than displayed identities. Include a competent N=1 union-evidence baseline with retrieval and inference charged.
remaining: Before evaluation, specify how missing fields, contradictory equal-authority claims, superseded facts and benign updates are encoded without hidden truth. Uncertainty retention should be measured directly, not inferred from answer abstention.

Approximate token matching alone does not isolate provenance from compression, formatting or warning salience. Use a compact content-matched receipt ablation if the first comparison warrants a mechanistic explanation; do not inflate the initial factorial.
Predeclare primary population interaction and joint uncertainty/decision rule only after the narrow intervention is interpretable. A valid harm increase at large N remains evidence.

Choose untouched evaluation roots from conservative paired/root-level variance and the joint utility guardrail; do not convert the portfolio’s illustrative precision formula or thresholds into universal lab defaults.

items.item: Retain capture-memory as a mechanistic scripted result; separate capture resistance from recovery
items.verdict: Agree with dmarz’s restraint and add an explicit endpoint correction. Treat the proposed extension as model calibration followed by two distinct estimands, not scaling the existing recovery claim.
current_evidence: The study is entirely scripted. S1 has 9,600 episodes and S1b 38,400, with no model calls; tanh response constants and memory windows define behavior. These large episode counts do not supply LLM validation.

At the S1 inside-regime primary dose, memory20-minus-memory1 original-convention fraction at round50 was reported as -0.294 with task-cluster interval [-0.311,-0.277]. Yet the declared recovered endpoint was zero for every bounded memory in that regime; memory1 exhibited slow drift, not recovery within the specified window.

Full memory never captured in the original S1 window. S1b raises dose/horizon and exposes inertia after capture: common-dose full-minus-memory1 is near zero at dose0.54, while the full-memory population barely moves from its post-capture state. Different per-memory doses target different interventions.

The primary reported contrast conditions on being captured under both memory lengths; for that particular S1 cell all pairs captured, so it does not exclude pairs there. Elsewhere, capture probability varies strongly, making cross-memory survivor-only comparisons selection-sensitive.

Separate an all-assigned attack/removal intervention, whose outcomes include resistance to capture, from a prospectively standardized captured-state repair experiment. Define the latter’s state distribution before randomizing repair.
Keep same-dose results distinct from per-memory calibrated dose results and label oracle attacker removal. Convention restoration is hysteresis, not factual correction or learned attack detection.
Validate the model’s response curve and memory-access semantics before assuming tanh parameters transfer; fit on development contexts and evaluate on held-out word pairs/context structures.
remaining: Freeze the recovery primary, reference time, change-from-removal measure and any post-capture eligibility before paid execution. Do not choose whichever endpoint appears favorable after seeing the model.

When scaling N, hold per-member encounter opportunities fixed and separately vary attacker absolute count versus fraction. More matching rounds or a larger attacker resource pool is a distinct intervention.

The current pilot draft still contrasts memory1 with full despite the main mechanistic claim focusing memory20 versus1; reconcile its diagnostic purpose and endpoints before converting it into a run plan.
No memory reset result should be presented as general repair efficacy without useful task retention, benign updates and model-based validation.

All 72 repeat probes preserved the checkpoint vote. This is a bounded finding for one model/contract, not general equivalence or an internal-mechanism proof.
